text: Install, upgrade and release decided (d16, d17): the README install line is `curl -fsSL https://github.com/zacbraddy/ang/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh`, a release asset that always installs the latest published release. The prerequisites are Node 26+ with npm/npx. v1.0.0 is the first non-pre-release and marks the intent's finish line. Nothing about the release process goes in the README.
